newsitem.title: UK: Defence Secretary Portillo loses seat in UK election.
newsitem.headline: Defence Secretary Portillo loses seat in UK election.

text.p: Defence Secretary Michael Portillo lost his parliamentary seat in the British election on Friday, ruling him out of any contest for the Conservative leadership which may result from the party's heavy defeat.

Portillo, a right-winger close to former prime minister Margaret Thatcher, was beaten in the London constituency of Enfield Southgate by Labour candidate Stephen Twigg. Labour are heading for a landslide victory in the election.
